description: This file declares functions related to the 'sdp' namespace, primarily for selecting and checking the capabilities of Spotlight Detection and Processing (SDP) backends and attention mechanisms, likely used in transformer models within the PyTorch framework.

methods.name: check_for_seq_len_1_nested_tensor
methods.description: Checks if the nested tensor sequence length is 1 based on the provided sdp parameters.

methods.name: select_sdp_backend
methods.description: Selects the appropriate SDP backend based on kernel parameters.

methods.name: is_flash_attention_available
methods.description: Determines if flash attention is available in the current environment.

methods.name: can_use_flash_attention
methods.description: Checks if flash attention can be used given the sdp parameters and debug flag.

methods.name: can_use_mem_efficient_attention
methods.description: Checks if memory-efficient attention can be used given the sdp parameters and debug flag.

methods.name: can_use_cudnn_attention
methods.description: Checks if cuDNN attention can be used given the sdp parameters and debug flag.
